text:
maria: Heads-up — p99 latency for /generate-text spiked ~3x after the new kernel selection rollout this morning. Noticed it on the per-route dashboard.
sam: saw that too. p50 barely moved, p95 up a little, but p99 tail exploded. Could be batching behavior interacting with the new kernel.
jordan: timeline? which kernel and which batch path? we pushed kernel-1.14 at 08:12 UTC and switched default batching heuristic to 'aggressive' at 08:30.
maria: exact. spike starts ~08:35 and aligns with higher batch sizes on routes with long context.
lee: KV cache hit-rate for that route dropped from 89% -> 72% around the same time. could be causing longer token latencies if cold-WARM transitions are more expensive with the new kernel.
sam: useful data — can we get token-level waterfall for a few p99 samples? want to see: kernel dispatch, kv-lookup, kv-miss penalty, batch-queue wait, generation time.
jordan: creating a quick query. sample prometheus-ish pseudo query:

```
topk(5, histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token_latency_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le, route)))
```

also need per-token stage metrics from runtime tracer.
maria: posting two p99 traces from observability. trace A = KV miss heavy; trace B = large batch with one long prefix causing recompile fallback.
ops-bot: deployment kernel-1.14 rolled back at 09:02 UTC for canary cluster (reason: p99 regression alert).
lee: rollback helped canary but prod still on 1.14 for a short while — we should confirm routing fallback rules triggered for some tenants.
sam: proposed action items:
- add a per-route SLI card in Console that surfaces p50/p95/p99 token-level breakdown (kv-hit vs kv-miss vs kernel-exec vs queue-wait)
- show throughput (reqs/s) and error rate adjacent
- expose batch-size distribution sparkline and 95th batch-size
- annotate deploys and kernel selection changes on the timeline

maria: +1. also add a column for 'kernel variant' so product owners can correlate perf with kernel/profile.
jordan: UX thought — keep card compact: primary metric p95 latency, small toggle to expand to token waterfall and traces. default to 24h window with quick switches to 1h/6h.
lee: instrumentation gaps:
- we currently only expose aggregate token_exec_ms; need to split kernel_dispatch_ms vs kernel_compute_ms
- batch-queue wait is in a debug metric not scraped to long retention
- KV metrics are per-process, not per-route; we need route-tagged kv_hit/kv_miss counters

sam: I'll open runtime PR to tag KV counters with route and to emit kernel_dispatch vs kernel_compute. Will also add a histogram for batch_wait_ms.
maria: for Console wiring: product wants a per-route card that can be pinned on the route overview. UX will accept a 2-row layout: left p95+p99+throughput, right mini waterfall+deploy annotations.
lee: timeline alerts: create a rule when p99 increases > 2x over baseline and kv_hit drops > 10% in same 30m window.
jordan: should we auto-fallback routes to safer kernel when p99 anomaly triggers? Ops concerns about correctness changes.
sam: safer kernel = kernel-1.12 which is validated for correctness and cheaper preemption. we can route a percentage in rollout or fallback fully if error-rate increases.
maria: plan: short term -> rollback on canary + emit missing metrics; medium -> Console card + alerting; long -> automated fallback policy enforcement.
lee: assigning owners: sam -> runtime metrics PR, jordan -> Console card mock + query templates, maria -> alerting rule + rollout playbook.
ops-bot: ticket created: RINF-4721 per-route SLI card + runtime metric tagging (owners: sam,jordan,maria).`
